blocks.content: The 42nd Amendment aimed to reduce the workload of High Courts and ensure faster justice through specialized bodies.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The 42nd Amendment served as the constitutional foundation for creating specialized bodies.
A primary goal of this amendment was to reduce the judicial burden and pending caseload of High Courts.
Specialized bodies were envisioned as a mechanism for accelerating the delivery of justice.
Identify the 42nd Amendment as the specific constitutional amendment aimed at reducing High Court workloads through specialized bodies/tribunals.
Note the twin objectives of the 42nd Amendment in this context: workload reduction for High Courts and faster justice delivery.
